description:

location: City Hall Community Chambers, 23 Russell Blvd, Davis, CA, 95616, United States
description:

The Board meetings occur on every first and third Thursday, in the City of Davis Community Chambers. 23 Russell Boulevard. Public session starts at 6:30 PM.  Meetings are cablecast live on Channel 17 (Comcast) or streamed on the DJUSD-TV website. 
  
The Davis Joint Unified School District’s Board of Education is comprised of five community members, responsible for setting district policy, approving the budget, and hiring the superintendent for schools in Davis, California. description:
Celebrate community, visibility, and joy at Davis Pride 2026, one of Northern California’s most vibrant and welcoming Pride events. The annual festival returns on Saturday, June 6, at Davis Civic Center Park (6th & B Streets). Attendees can expect a lively mix of live music, drag performances, community vendors, local organizations, and interactive activities. Pride begins at 4:00 pm. 
  
Organized by the Davis Phoenix Coalition, the festival continues to uplift marginalized voices while fostering connection, advocacy, and belonging. Beyond the main festival, Davis Pride is part of a broader lineup of events that span early June and invite participation from students, families, and activists alike. 
  
The event is free and open to all ages. 
Interested in making a donation? Go to: https://davisphoenixcoalition.app.neoncrm.com/forms/recurring-donation-form

title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note
description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering
Update 8/14/25:
**We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)

We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.

People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.

Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.

You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants and businesses.

Local beer, wine & mead

title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note
description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering
Update 8/14/25:
**We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)

We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.

People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.

Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.

You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants and businesses.
